authorized_openings.scope: Consumed. The descendant made exactly two actual gemini-2.5-flash calls through the exact Bernie keyless-ADC australia-southeast1 Vertex lane. Both failed closed at the deterministic proofreader and no further call is authorised.

notes: Yuri authorised the agent and proofreader to use one shared typed language.
Yuri authorised a strictly bounded natural-language operator note for audit and troubleshooting.
The note is independently proofread, audit-only, never parsed into the typed plan and never product-delivered.
No raw provider response, hidden reasoning, credentials, identifiers, real/product/patient/health/clinical/historical data, confirmation, write, production, deployment or release is authorised.

claim_scope: The provider-blocked shared PlanProgram implementation passes all six authored-synthetic proposal goals through one coded goal/operator/source representation consumed directly by the deterministic proofreader.
The independently proofread 320-byte operator note is admitted into audit only, cannot alter the compiled plan and is absent from the released proposal.
The credential-free non-root read-only network-none container rehearsal passes with bounded resources, zero provider/credential/database/write effects and complete owned cleanup.
Current official Google documentation lists gemini-2.5-flash and australia-southeast1 model availability/ML processing and documents structured arrays of objects with integer fields.

The fresh read-only preflight verifies the exact existing impersonated Bernie ADC, project, target, scope, Vertex API/billing/model entitlement, prediction-only role/permission, Data Access audit, absent request-response logging, disabled provider cache and no key/API-key path without changing external state.
Occupied lifecycle 001 closed before the broker consumed its request because pretty-printed cell JSON exceeded the relay cap; its ledger is consumed at zero provider calls and residue is absent.
Canonical compact cell-request serialization repairs that exact local transport defect without changing any semantic or external boundary, and a focused regression passes.
After that repair, the complete repository, provider-blocked, real-isolation, Continuity, Compass and exact read-only ADC/control gates passed again.

Occupied lifecycle 002 then made the descendant's first actual provider call: HTTP 200 through the exact Sydney lane. The independently bounded operator note passed, but the PlanProgram failed closed on output_index_invalid; no proposal or other value was released.

Model input v3 adds closed proofreader feedback and concrete zero-based output-code examples. Future audit retains only the integer typed form, separately from the bounded note. Complete provider-free and exact read-only controls pass again.

Lifecycle 003 then failed before broker_ready because the broker reconstructed v3 input without its feedback packet. Its ledger is consumed at zero calls; the exact host-side validation defect is repaired and all gates pass again.

Lifecycle 004 made the second and final actual provider call. Its bounded note passed, but the integer audit form proves the final move step referenced nonexistent output index 8 on the date-resolution step; the proofreader released nothing.

The absolute two-call ceiling is exhausted, every ledger is consumed and cleanup is complete. This is useful shared-language, audit and fail-closed evidence, not a successful live planner or reliable model-quality, real-data, production, deployment or release evidence.

decisions.summary: Proceed with one common model-proofreader PlanProgram and a separately bounded audit-only operator note, conditionally through the exact existing authored-synthetic Gemini 2.5 Flash Sydney lane.
Accept the mechanically lossless shared language, independently bounded operator note and zero-call real-isolation evidence; the occupied gate remains conditional on fresh exact ADC controls.
The fresh exact read-only Bernie ADC and cloud-control preflight passes, so one primary authored-synthetic occupied call is admitted under the frozen Sydney lane.

Close the first lifecycle at zero provider calls, preserve its consumed ledger and one-event audit, and accept compact canonical serialization as a bounded local transport repair before a distinct rerun.

The compact-transport regression, complete provider-free gates and fresh exact read-only Bernie ADC/control preflight all pass, admitting one distinct authored-synthetic occupied rerun under the unchanged Sydney lane.

Close the first actual call fail-closed after its typed program used an invalid output index, accept closed proofreader feedback and integer-form audit retention, and admit the one remaining exact-lane call after all gates pass again.
Close lifecycle 003 at zero provider calls, repair exact broker reconstruction of the feedback-bound v3 input, and readmit the one remaining actual call after complete gates pass again.

Accept the shared language and bounded-note implementation, close the second actual call fail-closed after an invalid typed dependency, exhaust the call ceiling and stop with zero release and complete cleanup.
